target_customer: Indian freelancers, agencies, exporters and startups that earn in foreign currency
problem: Receiving international payments in India is slow and costly with hidden fees. Infinity offers multi-currency accounts and INR settlement at a flat fee.
business_model: Transaction fee (flat 0.5 percent all-inclusive per its site) plus yield on idle cash in government securities
product_category: Fintech, cross-border payments and business banking

founders.name: Sourav Choraria
founders.background_notes: YC page: former head of growth at Paytm Money; launched India's first FD-backed secured credit card. Education not listed.

founders.name: Sidharth Choraria
education: Birla Institute of Technology, computer science
Indian School of Business, MBA in Finance
founders.background_notes: YC page: Amazon engineer and PM on the Appstore, founding engineer of Paytm Travel, platform engineer at MakeMyTrip. The founders are brothers.

competitors.name: Skydo
competitors.what: Cross-border payments for Indian exporters, freelancers and MSMEs with flat pricing
competitors.funding_then: 5.2M USD seed led by Elevation Capital in 2022

technical_complexity.rationale: Multi-currency accounts, INR settlement and compliance documents run on partner banks, so the work is integration and compliance rather than research.

defensibility.rationale: Copyable by existing payments firms. A third-party review says it relies on AD-1 banks rather than its own RBI cross-border license, which limits any regulatory moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Skydo later raised a 5M USD pre-Series A in Aug 2024 and a 10M USD Series A in Dec 2025. No incumbent acquired Infinity.

market_need_then: Indian freelancers and exporters faced delays and fees on international receipts, per founder stories, and Infinity claims 15K customers and 20M USD monthly volume on its site (company claim).

branding.domain_note: Uses infinityapp.in, not an exact match .com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Upbeat, benefit-focused, no hidden fees, uses emojis and exclamation points

branding.brand_signature: Flat 0.5 percent fee and 'no hidden fees' pitch
branding.community_and_virality: Reviewed by Wise and Xflow blogs as the 'Infinity App'.

brand_strength.rationale: A generic real word needing an 'app' suffix in the domain, with only third party review mentions.

outcome_analysis: Infinity is an active brother-led team of 15 in Bengaluru that raised a 1.9M USD pre-seed announced in February 2025 and claims 15K customers on its homepage. It competes with Skydo, which was already funded in 2022. Regulatory status as a payment intermediary is the main risk, and no later round is reported.
notes: Round confirmed by YourStory (Feb 2025) and the company homepage banner. Economic Times reportedly covered first funding in Dec 2024 (not opened). Aggregators list 2M and 2.4M USD totals, treated as rounding or estimates. Skydo seed year of 2022 comes from a search summary, YourStory Aug 2024 article cited as source; the 2022 date is not read from the page itself. Traction numbers are company claims.
